description:
WeRecoverData Utah: https://maps.app.goo.gl/js3UKhraP9oPyY4x7

I documented all their US addresses here: 44 of 46 are shared or virtual offices. https://consumerrights.wiki/w/User:Louis/WeRecoverData's_advertised_US_locations

People have been visiting these locations out of their own curiosity. I have not asked, or directed, a single person to visit one of these locations.

WeRecoverData's lawyer sent me a demand letter on June 19, 2026 listing this among statements they call "false, misleading, and commercially disparaging." Their exact words describing the statement they objected to were:

  "WRD maintains 'fake' or misleading business locations and that all 22 locations you purportedly  investigated are virtual offices that fail applicable criteria."
